summary.headline: Top frustrations with refrigerators: ice makers and water dispensers that keep failing, painful repair and warranty experiences, and compressors that stop cooling.
summary.text: Of 65 genuine posts (from 164 pulled; ~60% was ads, repair-shop promos and jokes), 58 are negative. Ice makers alone account for 21 posts, often repeat failures followed by $500–800 repairs, and 9 posts push back on smart features, which points to an opening for a simple, reliable, easy-to-repair fridge.
